root.name: diagnostic_read
root.purpose: Read bounded engineering error details visible to the current instance or session.
root.decision: 保持：调用者已经选择 section/offset/max_bytes，不能二次摘要
root.detail_access: 同工具按范围续读；scoped diagnostic 权限不变

root.name: instance_current
root.purpose: Read the bound research instance or return its direct local management URL.
root.decision: 修改：名称、状态、管理 URL；目标不再重复
root.detail_access: instance_current view=detail；不增加写权限

root.name: instance_list
root.purpose: List research instances without exposing internal identity.
root.decision: 修改：有限页与名称、标题、状态
root.detail_access: view=detail + limit/before

root.name: instance_close
root.purpose: Close the current research instance against further writes.
root.decision: 修改：名称、状态、管理 URL；目标不再重复
root.detail_access: instance_current view=detail；不增加写权限

root.name: scientific_inventory

root.decision: 修改：有限成果元数据页，独立目录入口
root.detail_access: limit/before；operation_catalog 按 ID detail

root.name: scientific_current
root.purpose: Read explicit current scientific-object selections for this research instance.
root.decision: 修改：稳定 kind 游标分页，保留选择事实
root.detail_access: limit/before

root.name: scientific_current_select

root.decision: 保持：无正文，无复制科学内容
root.detail_access: 原对象通过 artifact_catalog；变更授权保持

root.name: lifecycle_events
root.purpose: Return persistent semantic task, approval, and execution state changes for this scheduler process.
root.previous_default: 全差异并移动观察记录

root.name: artifact_ingest_file

root.decision: 保持：无正文，无复制科学内容
root.detail_access: 原对象通过 artifact_catalog；变更授权保持

root.name: artifact_ingest_text

root.decision: 保持：无正文，无复制科学内容
root.detail_access: 原对象通过 artifact_catalog；变更授权保持

root.name: artifact_catalog

root.decision: 修改：身份、schema、大小、parent_count

worker.name: worker_curve_contract_compile
worker.purpose: Compile the complete v1 curve contract from one experiment key, exact objective-target/reference-series bindings, candidate case keys, and one supported residual metric. The tool copies axes and units, calculates support domains and counts, creates identifiers and operators, writes output/result.json, and validates it.
worker.previous_default: 合同/请求/编译消息文件路径和计数
worker.decision: 保持：无完整科学对象内联；非分析前置门禁
worker.detail_access: 原工具返回的本 Run 文件

worker.name: worker_file_write_begin
worker.purpose: Begin a bounded new-file creation or chunked Codex patch. Omit expected_bytes for server-counted UTF-8; do not use TextEncoder. Existing files cannot be replaced wholesale.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_file_write_chunk
worker.purpose: Append one bounded UTF-8 or base64 chunk. Pass source as ordinary quoted strings or arrays of lines, never a JavaScript template literal containing Tcl ${...}.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_file_write_commit
worker.purpose: Atomically publish the complete active create-or-patch operation.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_file_apply_patch
worker.purpose: Apply one native Codex `*** Begin Patch`/`*** Update File` patch without hunk line counts, or one legacy standard unified diff, to an existing Run-relative text file; reject stale or ambiguous context atomically, then require a fresh read before another patch.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_extract_pdf_text
worker.purpose: Freeze a bounded PDF page range and return its exact local read-only path for native inspection.
worker.previous_default: 所选页面提取后的只读路径、字符计数
worker.decision: 保持：不是把 max_chars 全量文本塞进响应，无需降低取证能力
worker.detail_access: 精确本 Run 只读正文路径

worker.name: worker_curve_figure_inspect_source
worker.purpose: Recover original embedded images from one exact Agent-located PDF page, or canonicalize one exact raster source, and return only read-only source previews and deterministic source metadata. OCR and plot detection are not performed.
worker.previous_default: 最多32张源图元数据/完整提取请求及报告
worker.decision: 修改：首8个图引用和遗漏数量；完整 JSON 保存到只读详情
worker.detail_access: details_path + 图文件；不摘要原始图片

worker.name: worker_curve_figure_preview
worker.purpose: Run the same deterministic curve digitizer used by materialization for one draft request. Return read-only source-overlay and numeric-redraw paths for the current Agent to inspect before submitting the request.
worker.previous_default: 最多32张源图元数据/完整提取请求及报告
worker.decision: 修改：首8个图引用和遗漏数量；完整 JSON 保存到只读详情
worker.detail_access: details_path + 图文件；不摘要原始图片

worker.name: worker_curve_score
worker.purpose: Optionally score bound bundle/explicit CSV columns. Returns compact metrics; read calculation_path for the complete record. Cite the returned calculation_ref; the complete record and receipt are saved automatically. Unsupported metrics are never substituted.
worker.previous_default: 完整 CalculationRecord 含请求和多比较
worker.decision: 修改：原件先封存，再返回少量实际指标、计数与引用
worker.detail_access: calculation_path 完整只读记录，calculation_ref 正式引用

worker.name: worker_curve_diagnose
worker.purpose: Optionally localize one residual comparison using bound curves or explicit CSV columns. Returns compact metrics; read record.calculation_path for the complete record. Cite record.calculation_ref; record and receipt are retained automatically. Full details (<=4 MiB) and overlay/residual images have saved evidence aliases and task-local paths. One operator, 2-257 samples; no curve contract or additional Run.
worker.previous_default: 完整记录 + 图/详情引用
worker.decision: 修改：record 为计算摘要；图像权限、详情/证据保留

worker.name: worker_analysis_publish_files
worker.purpose: Retain a task-local analysis script and derived CSV/JSON/text/PNG files with declared source lineage. Returns reusable evidence aliases; does not execute code or attest its result. Script <=1 MiB; files <=16 MiB each, <=32 MiB per call, within the Run collection budget.
worker.decision: 保持：短 alias/path/hash 收据；每个实际发布文件均需可定位
worker.detail_access: 既有受控工作区文件和 tool evidence；不证明脚本执行

worker.name: worker_file_json_patch
worker.purpose: Atomically apply bounded JSON Pointer test/add/replace/remove operations to one existing Run-relative JSON file. Guard the update with the current content digest or a test operation; no textual context matching is used.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_file_delete
worker.purpose: Delete one optional Run-relative output file.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_file_move
worker.purpose: Move one optional Run-relative output file without rewriting its content.
worker.previous_default: 路径/字节/摘要校验值或错误
worker.decision: 保持：不回显整个正文或 diff；具体错误不改成泛化文本
worker.detail_access: 当前工作区文件；权限及原子编辑不变

worker.name: worker_tcad_debug_run
worker.purpose: Submit or poll one bounded TCAD development diagnostic; never scientific evidence. Budget: 360s reserved wall time and 6 created run names. Mode caps: initialization 120s, preflight 60s, smoke 180s. Each submitted job reserves its capped wall limit once, further clamped by project limits, remaining debug budget and Run time; solver failure does not refund it. Repeat the same name/mode to poll without new reservation; use a new name after source corrections, which do not reset the budget. Responses report current budget and per-job reservation. On updated runners, summary progress includes observed job elapsed_seconds. Read details_path for redacted log_tails and manifest timing; log_relative_path locates the complete bounded log. These are observations, not an ETA or proof of physical initialization. Older runners may omit progress.
worker.previous_default: 日志和完整诊断随轮询重复
worker.decision: 修改：状态、耗时、预算、具体错误和完整快照路径
worker.detail_access: details_path 同 Run 快照；log_relative_path 原日志；不授科学资格

worker.name: worker_tcad_curve_score
worker.purpose: Optionally parse bound TCAD PLX/log and explicit CSV columns, then score in this analysis Run. Returns compact metrics; read calculation_path for the complete record. Cite calculation_ref; control saves the record and receipt.
worker.previous_default: 完整 CalculationRecord 含请求和多比较
worker.decision: 修改：原件先封存，再返回少量实际指标、计数与引用
worker.detail_access: calculation_path 完整只读记录，calculation_ref 正式引用

worker.name: worker_tcad_curve_diagnose
worker.purpose: Optionally localize one residual comparison from bound PLX/log/CSV sources. Returns compact metrics; read record.calculation_path for the complete record. Cite record.calculation_ref; full details (<=4 MiB) and images have saved evidence aliases and task-local paths. One operator, 2-257 samples; no curve contract or additional Run.
worker.previous_default: 完整记录 + 图/详情引用
worker.decision: 修改：record 为计算摘要；图像权限、详情/证据保留

worker.name: worker_tcad_inspect_outputs
worker.purpose: Optionally list or inspect original files of the bound terminal execution_result. No solver, editing or renaming. A selected file yields a controlled evidence alias and read-only copy; unavailable inspection permits limited analysis.
worker.decision: 修改：目录首10项+遗漏计数；显式单文件检查保持
worker.detail_access: details_path 完整目录；单文件受控证据原件

worker.name: worker_tcad_accept_output
worker.purpose: Accept a previously inspected file as one declared output using an explicit evidence-backed mapping. Rechecks bytes; preserves source path and old execution. Read returned evidence alias for scoring and report references. No scientific success is granted.
worker.previous_default: 证据映射回执/文件位置
worker.decision: 保持：只有一个已检查文件的短回执；身份和 lineage 必须完整
worker.detail_access: 返回当前受控证据文件；同 execution 约束不变

lifecycle.name: worker_open_assignment
lifecycle.purpose: Open the exact Run assignment and materialize its private read-only inputs.
lifecycle.previous_default: 部分旧工作区和 hardened 内联工具目录
lifecycle.decision: Local 返回冻结合同路径/指针；Hardened 无 native 读取能力，保留原内联合同必要例外，避免返回不可读路径或新增通用读取权限。
lifecycle.detail_access: 本 Run 只读文件；legacy 同 identity 的受控原合同

lifecycle.name: worker_heartbeat
lifecycle.purpose: Record bounded liveness without extending the absolute budget.
lifecycle.decision: 保持：短回执，不能延长绝对预算

lifecycle.name: worker_submit_result
lifecycle.purpose: Validate, seal, and submit the complete result bundle, or return bounded correction diagnostics.
lifecycle.previous_default: 完成状态或有界纠错诊断
lifecycle.decision: 保持：不回显科学 JSON；没有可读详情引用时保留全部具体诊断，允许超体积目标
lifecycle.detail_access: 同 Run 纠错；Root diagnostic_after 翻查历史
